pages.title: Sickles
pages.text: Breaking an herb with a sickle will drop $(l:herbs/pounded_herbs)Pounded Herbs$() instead of the regular herb.$(br2)Sickles (and Wind Charges) can revert deterioration on certain blocks, such as Deteriorated Sacrificial Rune Blocks.

pages.title: Bottles of Life Force
pages.text: Enchanting your sickle with the Slashing enchantment will enable you to gather Bottles of Life Force. Attacking a mob with this enchantment applied while a Glass Bottle is in your offhand will fill it with the life of the attacked mob.

pages.title: Enchantments
pages.text: There are two other enchantments that you can apply to your sickles - Rapid and Culling.$(br2)Rapid increases your sneaking speed with each level.$(br2)Culling regenerates the player's health when killing lifestock such as Cows or Pigs. However, this does go on cooldown for a few seconds, so be wise with its use.
